Q1: Which steps of `tests-release-and-log-analysis` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` should move, and into which job?
Choices:
A) Read the step timings and job durations from run 40716905879 (one run read, host-side, before planning). Move the slowest steps, unchanged, into the non-matrix job with the shortest duration in that run (`static-checks`, `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` or `tests-promote-stall-and-review`). Stop once the source job's measured time is at or below about 12 minutes and the receiving job's projected time stays at or below about 75% of its own timeout. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Skip the timings and judge by size. Move the largest step blocks ("Promote cycle and blocked-verdict unit tests"; then, if needed, "Workflow log analysis contract tests" and "Semantic cache unit tests") into `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`.
C) Same as B, but the target is `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`.
**Note:** the `orchestrate-poll` job is a 5-group matrix, so a step moved there would run 5 times unless gated to one group. `static-checks` has only a 15-minute timeout. Neither is listed as a target for that reason.
Q2: Should the Node-based "Set up Node 22 for the claude-pool-broker Worker tests" and "claude-pool-broker Worker tests (vitest)" steps stay together in one job if either one moves?
Choices:
A) Yes. Move them as a pair or not at all, so the vitest step always runs after its Node setup in the same job. (RECOMMENDED)
B) No. Each step may move on its own.
